title: MES Video 0.1 — parameter vocabulary (spec/profiles/video.md §2)
description: Descriptors MUST use these names and shapes for the concepts they cover; a descriptor may narrow a shape (fewer enum values, a smaller range), never widen it.

negative_prompt.description: What to steer away from. Warn: supports.negative_prompt.

duration_s.description: generate: the clip's length, snapped to the model's frame grid (§1.4). Absent: the model's default, or the soundtrack's length.

fps.description: generate: the frame rate. Gate: supports.frame_rates.

target_fps.description: interpolate: the target rate; the engine uses the nearest factor the offer admits (§3.5).

size.description: The output size in pixels, snapped to the model's grid (§1.4).

aspect.description: W:H, with resolution; alternative to size.

resolution.description: With aspect: the short side in pixels.

keyframe_times.description: generate: one time in seconds per keyframes value, in order, strictly inside the clip (§3.1).

audio.description: Whether the output carries an audio track (§1.7). Absent: sound where the model makes it or the source has it.

after_s.description: extend: seconds to add after the source.

before_s.description: extend: seconds to add before the source. Gate: supports.extend_before.

retake.description: retake: what to make again in the span. Gate: supports.retake.

scale.description: upscale: the enlargement factor. Absent: the offer's native scale, reported.

content.description: upscale: what the video is. Required: never guessed.

factor.description: interpolate: frames per source frame interval.

seed.description: Repeatability (§1.13). Absent: the engine picks one and reports it.

frame_step.description: A model's frame grid: frames are k × multiple + offset (§1.4).
